intro: John is different from the other three Gospels. As John says himself, it's written that ye might believe.
Chapter one opens like Genesis: In the beginning was the Word. Chapters two to twelve tell of seven signs, and great I am sayings: the bread of life, the light of the world, the good shepherd.
Chapters thirteen to twenty-one slow down, to Jesus' last night with his disciples, his death, and his resurrection.
Tradition holds that John, the disciple whom Jesus loved, wrote it.
If you only listen to one book, many people would say: start here. Listen for the word believe.
